prose: Wayne McRoy Jr. returns to InnerVerse to discuss his newest book, The Demic Of Pan: Breaking The Natural Order. Supporting as co-host in this chat is Joshua Donohew, as we overview the ritual magic and archetypal influences on the psyche of the masses, the "hellenism hack" and the inverse alchemy of transhumanism, and much more.
ext: We explore Wayne's hypothesis that controllers plan to skip the Age of Aquarius, modern medical practices as occult ceremony, cognates to Pan such as Hermes and Enki, the Ahrimanic influence, internet as "mirror world" and the alien invasion within our psyche.
